name: the VAMPnet's slow shell-geometry coordinate
plain: A slow coordinate of a molecule's shell of neighbours that a learned search found. It carries a sliver more than the hand-made order parameter, under the bar SLOW-2 set for it.

carrier.state: the first learned coordinate of the VAMPnet dictionary (arm D)

basis.quote: Sixty per cent of D's leading slow function is therefore nonlinear shell geometry
basis.note: the coordinate is a learned function of the geometry of a molecule's shell of neighbours

views.reads: the VAMPnet's first coordinate, per molecule

stated.quote: the best of D/E/F: ≥ +0.02 beyond velocity and q on HELD-OUT, PS-2 ≤ 0.01

budget.quantity: the held-out R² a learned dictionary adds beyond velocity and q; the bar is SLOW-2's own stake C2, `≥ +0.02`. A stake's bar, not a law and not the removability gate's budget

regime: SLOW-1's walks: the rigid operator, 250 waters, 50 ps at 20 fs; trained on 293 K seeds 0 and 1, read on held-out seed 2

row.quote: | the VAMPnet's slow shell-geometry coordinate | yes, slower than q (`0.50` vs `0.33`) | a sliver, `+0.013` beyond q, under the bar | an uncarried sector |

not_claimed: NOT declared a sector. A sector owes a closure certificate, and SLOW-2 staked none for this coordinate: 'slower than q' is its own `σ₁` of `0.498` against `0.331` at 1 ps, with no bar. TIERS.md rounds these to `0.50` and `0.33`.

'Not carried' means under SLOW-2's chosen bar: `+0.0128`, interval `[+0.0121, +0.0139]`, against C2's `≥ +0.02`. The record gives an interval over training seeds and no standard error, so none is declared.
This increment was read by SLOW-2's own held-out search, not by the removability gate.
